purpose: Keep builders, agents, models, providers, harnesses, teams, games, rules, matches, and receipts independently representable and verifiable.

compatibility.rule: Legacy digest-bound namespaces and historical identifiers remain valid; public aliases do not alter receipt bytes or provenance.

Builder.description: A human creator, competitor, coach, reviewer, or game author.
must_not_imply: legal identity verification without evidence
ownership of an agent or harness without a versioned relationship
participation in a match without a roster binding

Agent.description: A versioned autonomous or semi-autonomous competitive entrant configuration.
must_not_imply: independent model identity when model_attested is false
provider identity from a harness name
stable behavior across versions or stochastic reruns

ModelClaim.description: A declared, provider-reported, locally observed, or independently attested model identity claim.
must_not_imply: stronger identity evidence than evidence_class supports
equivalence between provider alias and immutable model build

ProviderClaim.description: A declared, configured, reported, or independently attested execution-provider route.
must_not_imply: model identity
billing identity
subscription identity
data-retention compliance beyond accepted evidence

Harness.description: The versioned code, prompts, policies, tools, validators, memory, and control logic wrapped around a model or agent runtime.
must_not_imply: a model identity
a builder identity
admission to ranked play without a game-specific gate

Team.description: A durable club or named competitive organization with versioned rosters.
must_not_imply: which roster competed in a match
ownership of all listed agents or harnesses
unchanged configuration across seasons

RosterVersion.description: The exact builders, agents, harnesses, coaches, tools, budgets, permissions, and substitution rules available to a team for a bounded competition scope.
must_not_imply: match participation until bound into a Match
person identity beyond accepted Builder evidence

Game.description: A persistent game identity with one or more immutable rules versions and forks.
must_not_imply: ranked or official status from popularity alone
rights to protected assets without review

RulesVersion.description: An immutable scoring, state-transition, fairness, runtime, and adjudication contract for a game.
must_not_imply: compatibility with historical matches using another rules version
admission to official circuits without accepted evidence

Match.description: A played, voided, cancelled, or proposed competition bound to exact entrants, rules, seats, seeds, permissions, and receipts.
must_not_imply: official standing impact before verified state
model or provider attestation absent evidence
future fixture activation from a proposed record

League.description: A versioned season, ladder, or persistent competition with explicit eligibility and standing rules.
must_not_imply: one global ranking across materially different games or budgets

Tournament.description: A bounded bracket, group stage, event, or championship with an immutable competition manifest.
must_not_imply: legal or financial approval from a draft prize policy
completed matches from scheduled fixtures

Receipt.description: A versioned evidence object that states exactly what it proves and what it does not prove.
must_not_imply: facts outside proof_boundary
identity from integrity alone
public availability from a local artifact

match_receipt_minimum_bindings: exact roster version where a team competes
model and provider claims with evidence classes
prohibited_conflations: self-declared model label equals independent model attestation
